sessions.title: Chiara Mastroianni’s Closet Picks
sessions.description: The actor and star of Christophe Honoré’s Marcello Mio talks about the power of political films disguised as comedies, such as To Be or Not to Be and Divorce Italian Style; shares her love for Japanese horror cinema; and reminisces about what made her father, Marcello Mastroianni, such a revolutionary actor.
